# GitHub Copilot Project Instructions

This repository uses an Engineering Harness.

Always:

1. Follow the applicable AGENTS.md files.
2. Read existing implementation before creating new abstractions.
3. Prefer minimal changes.
4. Preserve API compatibility.
5. Run relevant tests after modifications.
6. Run ./scripts/verify.sh before declaring completion.
7. Report verification evidence.
8. Reply to users in Chinese.

Never bypass failing tests.

Do not perform unrelated refactoring.
